{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm as they are needed for the analysis
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and calculate mean flipper length
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Find the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()

# Print the results
print(mean_flipper_by_species)
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species}')"}
